entry.title: Antaño 1970 Cigarillos — Tin of 10
experienceTags: Occasion: Quick strong smoke, after a meal, evening smoke
entry.summaryHtml: Black pepper, earth, cocoa, coffee, cedar and dark-fruit sweetness are the expected core of this concentrated 4″ × 32 Nicaraguan puro. Antaño 1970 was deliberately built as an exceptionally strong, full-bodied blend, and the cigarillo keeps the same Nicaraguan Habano Criollo wrapper over Nicaraguan binder and ligero-heavy filler. Reports on the exact cigarillo describe dense smoke, early Nicaraguan pepper, cocoa and coffee with some black-cherry sweetness. It should be the harder-hitting and drier of the two Joya cigarillos, with substantially more nicotine than JOYA Black.
entry.noteHtml: Untasted. The Index currently lists the exact cigarillo singly at A$13 and the tin of 10 at A$119; Flavour remains unrated until personally tasted.

note: Add Joya de Nicaragua Antaño 1970 Cigarillo as an active untasted main-catalogue candidate. The Index live product data lists the exact 4 x 32 cigarillo at A$13 singly and A$119 per tin of 10. Joya de Nicaragua identifies Antaño 1970 as a handmade all-Nicaraguan puro built for exceptional strength; exact cigarillo listings specify Nicaraguan Habano Criollo wrapper with Nicaraguan binder and filler. Strength 8 and Quality 7 are projections; leave Flavour unrated until tasted.
